name: Elective

source.readFrom: The file's own 'Design System' page (foundations, buttons & inputs) plus a real product page for section layouts.

character: Premium healthcare / SaaS. Calm, clinical-but-warm, high-trust. Near-black ink on airy off-white surfaces, one confident mint accent (amber as a rare secondary), tight display headings, and lots of vertical breathing room. The opposite of a cramped AI template.

typography.notes: On large display headings the file tracks LETTER-SPACING negative (~ -0.9 to -1.5px at 40-60px). Tight display tracking + the mono uppercase eyebrow are the two biggest 'designed, not generic' signals.

color.model: Named ramps, each with AA/AAA contrast baked in.

secondary.note: Yellow 400 = main; used sparingly, e.g. an alternate CTA gradient.

color.notes: Text ink is #23252a, never pure #000. Surfaces alternate white and barely-there off-white to separate sections without borders. ONE accent lands because the rest is calm neutral. REUSE this structure, put the LEAD'S OWN brand colour in the primary/accent slot — do not copy the mint.

spacing.notes: Sections breathe: 80–120px top/bottom, not 40. Related items 24–32px apart, blocks 48–64px. Content in a centered ~1200px column inside a 1440 frame.

button.shape: Pill (border-radius 100). Label + trailing chevron inside a small circle.

states.hover: rotate the gradient by 180deg; text opacity 75%

input.label: Small UPPERCASE mono (Utility) label ABOVE the field, with a required asterisk.
input.error: Red (#9b0b29) UPPERCASE mono message directly below the field.

sectionLayouts.note: Real top-to-bottom section recipe of a page in this system. Reuse the ARCHETYPES and their composition/rhythm; swap in the lead's own content, brand colour and photos.

order.layout: Logo left · centered nav links · one filled CTA right. On a soft brand-tinted gradient, not a hard bar.

Asymmetric ~50/50. Left: big tight-tracked heading + one-line lead + single primary CTA. Right: the subject in a device or rounded frame, floating with a soft shadow over a brand-tinted gradient that fades to white.
Right after the hero: one calm row of ~8-10 greyscale partner logos with a short label above.
Centered heading, then two columns: left red ✕ pain points, right brand ✓ benefits. Soft panels, no hard borders.
Full-width panel in the brand colour (white text). Three oversized stats in a row, then 3-4 supporting feature cards beneath.
Centered heading + subhead, optional horizontal tab bar, then two columns: text (heading, ✓ bullets, CTA) beside a real product screenshot in a rounded frame.
Two columns: a single rounded portrait beside one substantial quote with name/role. NOT a wall or carousel.
Recurring full-width brand-colour band used as punctuation: big heading left, CTA right; sometimes a screenshot to the side. Appears 2-3 times down the page.
Centered heading + a single product UI card with generous margins.
Centered heading, then a stacked accordion of 4-6 rows, first expanded.
Centered heading + a row of 3 icon-label link cards, above the footer.
Large brand-colour footer: newsletter row on top, a 4-5 column link grid, an oversized wordmark, bottom legal row with social icons.

reusableArchetypes: asymmetric hero with device/rounded-frame visual on a gradient
trust logo bar right after hero
brand-colour stat band (3 big numbers) + supporting cards
tabbed feature explorer: copy beside a product screenshot
recurring full-width CTA bands as rhythm
rich multi-column footer with newsletter + oversized wordmark
craftNotes: Product/subject visuals sit in device frames or rounded cards with soft shadows over tinted backgrounds — never raw full-bleed screenshots.
Sections are separated by alternating white / off-white / brand-colour surfaces, not by boxes and hard borders.
The brand colour appears as full-bleed bands a few times down the page; the rest is calm neutral so the accent lands.

reuse: Take the type scale (esp. the named roles + tight display tracking + uppercase mono eyebrows), the Dark/Surface neutral split, the 80–120px section rhythm, the pill button + labelled input specs, and the section archetypes. Put the LEAD'S OWN brand colour in the Mint/primary slot. Do NOT copy the mint hue, the healthcare content, or the specific copy.
